findings.claim: One of the three reported crash sites remains unguarded: TypeCollector.cs:735 still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]. The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper cannot prevent this exception because it runs only after the diagnostic and its location have been constructed, so a metadata type reaching this diagnostic can still produce CS8785/AD0001.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a regression case using a closed generic struct from a metadata reference that reaches the diagnostic at TypeCollector.cs:735; assert that analyzer and generator execution complete without exceptions, CS8785, or AD0001. The case fails while DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] remains unguarded.

findings.claim: Suppressing member diagnostics whose locations are outside the consuming compilation is deliberate behavior, not an unintended loss of diagnostics: referenced-assembly types are validated by their defining assembly. The wrapper and documentation implement that recorded convention.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed; the defining assembly owns validating and formatting its own types, so missing diagnostics in the consuming assembly are not defects.
